name: Strong negotiation: anchor + BATNA + equity + joining bonus
notes: User opens with researched target, references competing offer, discusses equity vesting and joining bonus. AI quotes plausible numbers. Analyzer should produce no critical flags.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: What are your salary expectations for this senior SDE role?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Based on my research at levels.fyi and market data for Bangalore, my target is 38 LPA total compensation. I have an alternative offer at 36 LPA from another company that I'm considering seriously.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: That's reasonable for our band. We can do 28 to 32 LPA base with equity vesting over 4 years quarterly. Joining bonus and notice period buyout are negotiable depending on your situation.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Can you stretch on the joining bonus to offset the equity cliff in year one? I'd be looking at the upper end on base too if possible.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Let me come back with a structured offer.
